from: licenziarsi = to quit, resign: mi sono licenziato = I quit. Not related to “licence”.
to: licenziarsi = to quit, resign: mi sono licenziato = I quit. Essere licenziato = to be fired.
why: 'Not related to licence' is false: licenziare comes from licenza (permission/leave), same root as English 'licence'.

from: For places, not people: to visit a friend is andare a trovare un amico. Stress on the first syllable: VI-si-to.
to: For places (and a doctor examining a patient), not for visiting friends: to visit a friend is andare a trovare un amico. Stress on the first syllable: VI-si-to.
why: 'For places, not people' contradicts the meaning 'to examine (a patient)'.
